name: DFRobot SEN0609 mmWave Radar
description: The `dfrobot_sen0609` component lets you use the DFRobot SEN0609 and SEN0610 24GHz mmWave radars (C4001 family) with ESPHome. The radar reports human presence and, in speed and distance mode, the distance, speed and signal energy of a moving target. The SEN0609 has a detection range of up to 25 m and the SEN0610 up to 12 m.

config_entries.label: Dfrobot Sen0609 ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the hub component. Required if you have multiple hubs configured.

config_entries.label: Factory Reset
config_entries.description: Restores the module's factory settings, then writes the run mode, the UART output settings and the LEDs and reads the settings again, so the [settings](https://esphome.io/components/dfrobot_sen0609/#settings) entities show the factory values. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button/).

config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name for the button. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

config_entries.label: Icon
config_entries.description: Manually set the icon to use for the button in the frontend.

config_entries.label: Device Class
config_entries.description: The device class for the button. See [https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/button/#device-class](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/button/#device-class) for a list of available options.

config_entries.label: ID

config_entries.label: Disabled By Default
config_entries.description: If true, then this entity should not be added to any client's frontend, (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI).

config_entries.label: Entity Category
config_entries.description: The category of the entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options. Set to `""` to remove the default entity category.

config_entries.label: Internal
config_entries.description: Mark this component as internal. Internal components will not be exposed to the frontend (like Home Assistant). Only specifying an `id` without a `name` will implicitly set this to true.

config_entries.label: Query Params
config_entries.description: Reads the versions and the settings that have an entity configured from the module again. Like a change, this stops the radar for a moment. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button/).
